publicSafety: Public status URLs, dates, author handles, record types, displayed public URLs, and dated aggregate counts only; post text, cookies, private account state, and session data are excluded.

populationReconciliation.conclusion: Every unique record materialized by the authenticated Posts and Replies timelines was reviewed. Three profile-counted records did not materialize and remain unrecovered; 107 of 110 is not represented as 100% of the profile counter.
populationReconciliation.timelineMembershipMethod: Each union record preserves whether it materialized in the exhausted Posts timeline, Replies timeline, or both. Status links nested inside quoted-post cards were excluded from the primary-record population.

limitations: Counts are point-in-time interface observations, not unique people, reach, conversion, endorsement, or impact.
Authenticated button state can reflect the viewing account's own prior actions; only the displayed aggregate numbers were counted.
Deleted posts, private interactions, native reposts that did not materialize, and historical count changes are unavailable.
The public timeline review recovered 107 of the profile's reported 110 posts; three records did not materialize.
A tag or credit by @CallNYCApp is not counted as engagement unless another account visibly replied, reshared, quoted, or acknowledged it.
Institutional and shared-account records are not attributed to an individual author without additional evidence.
Visible interaction counts are volatile historical interface observations and remain knowledge-bank context rather than headline impact metrics.
